style.why: 本示例锁定已准入的四格画风修订

items.what: 小雨第一次烤蛋糕：看菜谱、面粉撒出、蛋糕塌陷、她吃同一只失败的蛋糕
items.subject: A four-panel slice-of-life comic about the same girl baking her first cake
panels: She reads a recipe book with great determination.
Flour bursts everywhere as she mixes too hard.
The plain brown cake comes out of the oven visibly collapsed, with no frosting or fruit decoration.
She laughs and eats a rough slice cut from the very same visibly collapsed, undecorated plain brown cake from panel 3. No repaired or replacement cake.
items.relations: Panel 3 and panel 4 show the same failed cake. It stays sunken and undecorated when she eats it; do not replace it with an intact strawberry-and-cream cake.

characters.desc: A young student with a slim build, two small round hair buns, big round glasses, a crescent-moon hair clip above her left ear, and an oversized hoodie with a front pocket.

items.why: 四格讲清起承转合，同时让同一角色和蛋糕在相邻格保持连续
